evidence.detail: The exact client developer command 'particle' obtains rs/l/f/e.g(), the live rs/l/f/a/f/c manager, and emits this rs/l/f/a/f/a record family through it; this independently fixes the abstraction as particles rather than generic rectangles.

Each instance owns x/y position, original position, width/height, packed color, alpha, lifetime, movement direction and animation parameters, and renders itself as one alpha-blended colored rectangle.

The update path moves x according to the exact LEFT/RIGHT direction enum, applies vertical motion/curve state, fades alpha over its randomized finite lifetime and exposes expiry when elapsed time reaches that lifetime.

The same record is emitted by multiple UI subsystems including Donation Shopping Cart particle presentation, raid-affliction UI, item-dialogue effects and mailbox effects, proving it is a shared overlay particle rather than a domain-specific cart/raid object.

candidates.note: OverlayParticle is descriptive exact-behavior recovery for the shared UI-overlay particle record. The exact developer command 'particle', finite movement/fade lifecycle and cross-subsystem UI reuse distinguish it from R50's separate world/scene Particle. Confidence is 0.998.

evidence.detail: The enum preserves exactly two constants: RIGHT and LEFT.
OverlayParticle stores this enum directly and its update loop increases x for RIGHT and decreases x for LEFT; OverlayParticleManager assigns the directions when emitting mirrored particle groups.

candidates.note: OverlayParticleDirection follows the exact surviving RIGHT/LEFT enum literals and their exclusive use by OverlayParticle horizontal movement. Confidence is 0.999.

evidence.detail: The exact client developer command 'particle' calls rs/l/f/e.g() and invokes this class's four-argument emission helper twice with explicit count/position/color values.

The class extends the live overlay renderer base, owns active and removal particle lists, renders/updates every OverlayParticle each frame, moves expired particles to the removal list and clears them deterministically.
Its emission helper creates four directional groups per request, alternates LEFT/RIGHT movement, configures vertical motion, size, alpha and color, and caps the active list at 1000 particles.

Exact bytecode references the manager/particle family from Donation Shopping Cart, raid-affliction, item-dialogue, mailbox and client developer-command paths, establishing one reusable UI-overlay particle manager.

candidates.note: OverlayParticleManager is descriptive exact-behavior recovery for the shared live overlay renderer/emitter reached by the exact developer command 'particle' and reused across multiple UI subsystems. Confidence is 0.998.
